html:
The Cambodian Civil War was fought between the government of Lon Nol, backed by the United States, and the communist Khmer Rouge, backed by North Vietnam and China. It began after Lon Nol ousted Sihanouk in March 1970.

American bombing, aimed at Vietnamese bases and supply lines, hit much of the countryside from 1969 to 1973, killing many and driving peasants towards the rebels and into the cities. Phnom Penh swelled with refugees.

On 17 April 1975 the Khmer Rouge entered Phnom Penh and at once emptied the city. Their rule under Pol Pot followed. See Vietnam War.
